reasons.why: Kalshi counts seats held after the midterms (incl. holdovers, exact or bands of 5); offshore counts by its own seat rules and brackets differ (≤47 vs Below 45/45/46/47). Not identical.
Kalshi pays on a company CONFIRMING an IPO; offshore pays on COMPLETING one. Different events.
Kalshi settles on CF Benchmarks at its own hour; offshore on Binance/Chainlink at another. Different numbers.
Different stations and reports (NWS climate report vs Wunderground).
Kalshi "next head of state" vs offshore "head of state at end of 2026". Different events.
Offshore books under $50k depth or brackets that do not line up with Kalshi strikes; dropped by the volume rule.
